_comment: Live SEP-24 GET /info deposit capture (#1095), captured by hand against the anchor's own advertised transfer server the same way tests/fixtures/sep38/capability-capture.json was. SEP-6 /info (https://ntokens-box.bpventures.us/sep6/info) was checked too and shows the identical BRL/enabled:false shape.
reason: The anchor explicitly advertises deposit for its registered asset (BRL) with enabled: false — unlike cowrie/anclap/ngnc, where the registered asset is simply absent from the deposit map, ntokens names it and turns it off outright. withdraw.BRL is enabled; deposit.BRL is not.
